description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330015683892 SEAL,NONMETALLIC SP: Line 0001 Qty 132 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0054 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
